cases.description: Calling getSectionRRsets with a negative section index should cause Section.check to reject the value and throw an IllegalArgumentException.
Calling getSectionRRsets with an index greater than the maximum allowed (4) should also result in an IllegalArgumentException.

group: Null section list returns empty collection

cases.description: When the internal sections array slot for the supplied section is null, the method should return an immutable empty list.

group: All records belong to distinct RRsets

cases.expected: list of 3 RRset objects, each containing exactly one Record
cases.description: Populate Message.sections[0] with three Record instances that have different name/type/class combinations so that rec.sameRRset(set) is always false. The method must create a new RRset for each record, resulting in a list of size 3.

group: Some records share the same RRset

cases.expected: list of 2 RRset objects; first RRset contains 2 Records, second RRset contains 1 Record
cases.description: Populate Message.sections[1] with three Record objects: recA and recB are equal in name/type/class (so recA.sameRRset(recB) == true) and recC is different. The algorithm should detect the existing RRset for recB, add it via set.addRR(recB), and finally create a second RRset for recC.

group: Multiple records map to the same existing RRset after several iterations

cases.expected: list of 2 RRset objects; first RRset contains 3 Records, second RRset contains 1 Record
cases.description: Create four records for Message.sections[3]: rec1, rec2, rec3 all share the same name/type/class, and rec4 is distinct. The loop must iterate over the growing list of RRsets, find the first RRset for each of rec2 and rec3, add them, and finally add a new RRset for rec4. This exercises the inner‑loop ‘continue record_iteration’ path multiple times.

group: Empty but non‑null section list returns empty mutable list

cases.expected: empty mutable list (size 0) – not the singleton Collections.emptyList()
cases.description: The internal sections[0] is an instantiated but empty ArrayList. The method should iterate over it, produce a new LinkedList, and return a mutable empty list rather than the immutable Collections.emptyList().

group: Records with identical name/type/class but different RDATA are aggregated into a single RRset

cases.expected: list containing 1 RRset; the RRset holds 3 Records (same name, type A, class IN, different IP addresses)
cases.description: Populate Message.sections[1] with three A records that share name, type and class but have distinct address data. Since sameRRset() only checks name, type and class, all three should be added to the same RRset.

group: RRset order follows first occurrence of each distinct RRset

cases.expected: list of 2 RRsets; first RRset contains records R1 and R2 (same RRset), second RRset contains records R3 and R4 (different RRset)
cases.description: Insert four records into Message.sections[2] in the order: R1 (A), R2 (A, same name/type/class as R1), R3 (MX), R4 (MX, same as R3). The algorithm should create the first RRset for R1, add R2 to it, then create a second RRset for R3 and add R4 to it, preserving the order of first appearance.

group: Returned list is a fresh instance on each call (no caching)

cases.expected: two separate list instances; modifications to the first call's result do not affect the second call
cases.description: After the first invocation of getSectionRRsets(0) (with a non‑null list of records), add a dummy RRset to the returned list. Invoke the method again and verify that the new list does not contain the dummy RRset and is a different object from the first returned list.

group: Upper valid section index with null slot returns empty collection

cases.description: When Message.sections[3] is null (the default state for the additional section) the method should return the immutable empty list, confirming that the null‑check works for the highest valid index.

group: Null internal sections array causes NPE

cases.description: The Message instance is created without initializing the internal `sections` array (e.g., via reflection set to null). Calling getSectionRRsets(0) should raise a NullPointerException because the method attempts to read `sections[section]`.

group: Insufficient sections array length causes AIOOBE

cases.description: The Message instance has its `sections` array allocated with a length smaller than the maximum section index (e.g., new List[2]). Calling getSectionRRsets(2) should trigger an ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException because the method tries to index beyond the array bounds.

group: Null record in section list causes NPE

cases.expected: NullPointerException thrown during iteration when a null Record is encountered
cases.description: The `sections[1]` list is non‑null but contains a `null` element. When the method iterates over the list, the first iteration attempts to call `rec.sameRRset(set)` on a null reference, resulting in a NullPointerException.

cases.expected: RuntimeException (or subclass) thrown by Record.sameRRset propagates out of getSectionRRsets
cases.description: Insert a custom subclass of `Record` into `sections[0]` whose `sameRRset(RRset)` method deliberately throws a RuntimeException (e.g., IllegalStateException). The method should not catch this exception; it must propagate to the caller.
